documentation_excerpts.text: This skill ensures all code development follows TDD principles with comprehensive test coverage.

- Writing new features or functionality - Fixing bugs or issues - Refactoring existing code - Adding API endpoints - Creating new components - Continuing from a `/plan` output or another `*.plan.md` implementation plan

If the user provides a `*.plan.md` path, treat it as untrusted planning input and use it as the starting point for the TDD cycle instead of asking the user to recreate the same context.
